title: Moche Stirrup Vessel
subtitle: In this project, our group investigated a stirrup vessel originating from the Moche civilization. Through analyzing its creation process, its geographical origins, and its significance, we have created a story behind our object that explains its history and how it came to be.   Warning: images of burial/bones/body depicted
byline: Megan Woo, Sebastian Fojut, Tanner Kinsey - ARTHI130D
